metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow gifted a kill? Valorant aim’s on a vacation again
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I dropped my controller
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did that even connect? No idea but I’m cashing in
Click if your aim ever ghosts you but still wins!

Tap if your aim ever takes a coffee break but somehow still clutches!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
